original_idea.body: Prefilling attacks with varying compliant-prefix lengths; plot recovery curve per open model (arXiv:2406.05946).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: mapping shallow-alignment recovery depth yields a model-agnostic robustness diagnostic.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prefilling attacks + prefix-length sweep, inference-only, no training.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single experiment (recovery curve vs prefix length).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, open weights, runs without proprietary tooling.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference with prefill control on 7-8B models.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Recovery boundary as a function of prefix length plausibly not systematically mapped.
